objective: A reusable formal assurance workflow covering every current Lab definition and every future addition or revision, with semantic distinction obligations and combined-theory consistency checks.
source_selection: Resolve current_lookup to exact version entries, verify bytes and digests, and record candidates and predecessors separately.
required_outputs: Exact current-definition baseline and complete formalization coverage queue
Reviewed interpretation bindings with signatures, assumptions, dependencies, examples and claim ceilings
Declared inter-concept relation matrix and semantic non-collapse obligations
Executable checks and exact proof, witness or counterexample evidence
Incremental addition/revision gate with dependency invalidation and full snapshot regression
Owner-facing revised definitions and realistic examples before admission

result_policy.aggregate_readiness: Derived from all required current obligations and reviewed interpretation coverage; unknown, unsupported, missing and stale evidence cannot become success.
result_policy.admission: Formal evidence never independently grants semantic admission or runtime activation. Admission workflow enforcement is a candidate integration until separately reviewed.

tasks.purpose: Pin sources, audit existing formalization and checks, produce the full coverage queue.
Define obligation semantics, evidence contracts, relation classes and source-fidelity review.
Run a small real semantic pilot with positive witnesses, deliberate collapse, contradiction and vacuity controls.
Deliver deterministic incremental checks, source invalidation, reports and candidate admission integration.
Formalize every current definition by dependency-connected families and review each interpretation.
Evaluate the complete selected formal theory, reconcile cross-family contradictions and report all remaining limitations.
Show exact revised package and examples for owner admission, then execute only selected effects.

completion: All current identities are accounted for; every supported reviewed formal interpretation has reproducible non-collapse and consistency evidence; unresolved semantics or unsupported logic are explicitly dispositioned by the owner; future changes cannot bypass required evidence or currentness checks. Universal automatic decidability is not asserted.
